blocks.text: Peritoneal dialysis mein peritoneal membrane istemal hoti hai, jo pait ki cavity (abdominal cavity) ki andar ki tah hai. Is amal mein 1.5 se 2 litre dialysate catheter ke zariye mareez ke pait mein dala jata hai. Dialysate 4 se 6 ghante pait mein rehne diya jata hai. Is dauran peritoneum ki khoon ki capillaries se fuzlaat aur zaid mayi dialysate mein aa jate hain. Phir dialysate pait se nikal kar phenk diya jata hai. Fuzlaat aur zaid mayi achhi tarah nikalne ke liye yeh amal din mein kai baar dohraya jata hai.
